Ability.NoRollTableResult: No result matches the rolled value.
Ability.ReferenceMissing: The referenced Ability could not be found. Check its world or compendium reference.

Advancement.CapabilitiesDialogHint: Distribute 4 points among your three Pools (total must be exactly 4).
Advancement.Hint: Buy four different advancements at 4 XP each. One Other option may replace one main option. Choose all free new-tier abilities before completing the fourth purchase; choices cannot be saved for later.
Advancement.Interrupted: An advancement was interrupted after a write. Further progression is blocked until the GM reconciles XP, Items and advancement state.
Advancement.Invalid: Advancement refused. Check the tier, training requirements, available choices and purchases already made at this tier.
Advancement.NewTierFocus: The character gains a new free Focus ability (tier {tier}).
Advancement.NewTierGenre: The character also gains a free Genre ability (tier {tier}).
Advancement.NoAttackCategory: No weapon category (general skill, defense or special ability)
Advancement.NoChoices: No eligible source-backed ability is available. Check the current genre, Focus prerequisites and pending tier.
Advancement.OrNewSkillName: ...or name of a new trained skill
Advancement.OtherArmorNote: The character can now freely use all armor categories.
Advancement.OtherFocusNote: The selected Focus ability has been granted.
Advancement.OtherGenreNote: The selected Genre ability has been granted.
Advancement.OtherWeaponsNote: The character can now freely use all weapons.
Advancement.ReconcileHint: First reconcile XP, granted Items, bought slots and free choices on the actual character. Confirm only when those changes are complete. This clears the interruption without refunding XP or rolling back state.
Advancement.ResolvePending: Resolve the existing pending Focus choice before buying another advancement.
Advancement.SkillGates: General specialization requires tier 2. Attack and defense training requires tier 2, specialization tier 4. Existing expert training cannot be bought with this advancement.

Armor.AppliesToAllSpeed: applies to all Speed tasks — armor not freely usable
Armor.ConfirmRepair: Clear all accumulated damage to the armor's Block bonus?
Armor.DamageHint: A special attack or GM intrusion reduces the armor's Block bonus by 1 step — never its Dodge hindrance.
Armor.DamagedNote: {name}'s armor is damaged: its Block bonus is reduced.
Armor.ItemHint: Select "Equipped" to use this armor. Equipping it automatically unequips any other armor.
Armor.ManageInInventory: To change armor, select "Equipped" on the armor Item. Only one armor can be equipped at a time.
Armor.NoArmorEquipped: No armor equipped — nothing to damage.
Armor.NoBlockBonusToDamage: This armor has no Block bonus left to damage.
Armor.Title: Armor

Attack.ConfigurationChanged: {name} switched to {configuration}. This switch costs one action.
Attack.ExtremeRangeHint: The GM confirms the target is at the weapon’s range limit. This hinders the attack by one step; token distance is not calculated.
Attack.FreelyUsable: This specific weapon is freely usable (override)
Attack.OneHandedHint: This weapon hinders the attack when fired with one hand.
Attack.Title: Attacks

CustomField.Hint: Add anything specific to your character that the system doesn't already provide for (status, reputation, ally, debt, etc.).
CustomField.Label: Field Name
CustomField.Title: Custom Fields

Cypher.Title: Cyphers
Cypher.Used: This cypher has been used and is now depleted.

CypherLife.capacity: The cypher limit is reached or exceeded. Free a carried slot before acquiring or retrieving another cypher.
CypherLife.discardHint: Discard the selected cyphers as one action. Their effects do not activate.
CypherLife.effectsDeferred: Activation consumes the cypher. Its particular power still requires adjudication.
CypherLife.physicalOnly: Only manifest cyphers can be stashed or physically transferred.
CypherLife.reconcileHint: Inspect both inventories and correct any missing or duplicate item first. This records your correction without creating, deleting or consuming a cypher.
CypherLife.superheroHint: Choose this optional table only for a superhero campaign approved by the GM.
CypherLife.transferHint: Choose a writable character, or target an unlinked token to transfer to that token. Only a physical cypher can be transferred.
CypherLife.unavailable: This cypher operation is unavailable. Check ownership, capacity, custody and action timing.
CypherLife.unset: Form to be chosen by the GM

Defense.BlockSuccess: Block succeeded: the {severity} wound is reduced by one step.
Defense.DodgeSuccess: Dodge succeeded: the wound is avoided entirely.
Defense.Failed: Defense failed: a {severity} wound is taken.
Defense.Title: Defense

Depletion.EquipmentHint: This equipment uses depletion instead of a fixed quantity (like a medical bag or aspirin in the CRD).
Depletion.Hint: When you use this artifact, click the die to roll its depletion check. "Never depletes" corresponds to the CRD's "—" notation.
Depletion.LastUse: Works, but that was the last use — now depleted.
Depletion.Title: Depletion: {name}

Descriptor.AlreadyApplied: A descriptor has already been applied to this character.
Descriptor.ApplyPrompt: Apply the {name} descriptor to this character.
Descriptor.Label: Descriptor
Descriptor.SkillOptionsHint: Enter up to four skill choices and leave unused fields empty. An "Other" choice allows skills covered by the CRD’s "or similar" wording.
Descriptor.SpeciesAlreadyApplied: A species has already been applied to this character.
Descriptor.SpeciesWrongGenre: This species is not available for the character's genre.
Descriptor.StatOptionsHint: Select the Pools eligible for this Descriptor’s bonus. Select two, such as Speed and Might, only when the CRD offers that choice.

Environment.confirmInterval: Has the declared interval passed since the previous occurrence? Confirm only if that time has passed in the fiction.
Environment.hint: The GM declares the defense, consequences and interval. No falling, fire, cold or suffocation damage table is inferred. Saving does not apply damage. Conditions remain until explicitly ended.
Environment.immune: Declared immunity to all this profile's consequences
Environment.interval: Repeat interval in game seconds (0 = once)
Environment.manualHint: Some consequences may already be saved. Reconcile the sheet and chat before ending this exposure and declaring a replacement. Automatic replay is blocked.
Environment.name: Danger or circumstance
Environment.noPhysicalMovement: This defense requires no physical movement
Environment.poolReduction: Reduce each occurrence's Pool damage by this many points
Environment.protected: The declared protection prevents all consequences; no defense cost was spent.
Environment.protectionHint: Name the applicable source before applying a reduction or immunity. Armor, shields and equipped Items are not selected automatically. Declare a new profile if protection changes.
Environment.protectionValue: {source}: wounds −{wounds} severity steps; Pool damage −{pool} points
Environment.source: Protection source adjudicated by the GM
Environment.stat: Defense stat (when a defense is required)
Environment.title: Environmental hazards
Environment.unavailable: This exposure is unavailable. Check the elected GM, permissions, declared consequences, elapsed interval and current occurrence.
Environment.woundReduction: Reduce each declared wound by this many severity steps

EquipmentHands.crewHint: The acting character counts as one operator. Participants must be distinct actual characters and able to operate the weapon. Participation and deployment are explicit declarations; no distance, bonus or action cost is inferred.
EquipmentHands.hands: Occupied hands (0 only for an explicitly hands-free attack or object)
EquipmentHands.handsFull: Not enough free hands. Stow another object or ask the GM to adjust available hands.
EquipmentHands.hint: Carrying equipment does not occupy hands. Declare what is actually held. Heavy weapons require two hands unless their source explicitly permits hindered one-handed use. Stowing an object keeps it in inventory. Conflicting grips never unequip another object.
EquipmentHands.hold: Hold / ready this object or attack
EquipmentHands.invalid: Declaration refused. Check free hands, source requirements, shield possession and available distinct operators. Nothing else was unequipped.
EquipmentHands.needCrew: Assign enough distinct available operators before attacking.
EquipmentHands.needGrip: Declare that this attack or object is held before using it.
EquipmentHands.needTripod: Deploy the required tripod before attacking.
EquipmentHands.needTwoHands: The declared number of hands does not satisfy this weapon's requirements.
EquipmentHands.operators: Other participating operators (Ctrl/Cmd to select several)
EquipmentHands.title: Hands and weapon setup
EquipmentHands.zeroHint: A zero-hand attack must first be declared by the GM for this Item. This cannot bypass a heavy or explicitly two-handed weapon requirement.

FocusSelection.AlreadyApplied: A Focus has already been applied to this character.
FocusSelection.ApplyPrompt: Apply {name} and choose its two initial tier-1 abilities.
FocusSelection.ArmorItemDescription: This armor is freely usable only while the corresponding Focus ability is active.
FocusSelection.ChooseAbilityPrompt: Choose the Focus ability gained at tier {tier}.
FocusSelection.ChooseExactlyTwo: Choose exactly two tier-1 Focus abilities.

FocusSheet.ChooseWeaponAttackCategory: Choose a weapon attack category when gaining this ability
FocusSheet.Label: Focus
FocusSheet.NoAbilities: No abilities are stored on this Focus.

General.ActionPrevented: A current condition or guarding prevents this action. Defenses remain available while stunned.
General.DefenseSuccess: The defense succeeds; the declared effects are avoided.
General.GuardStopped: The guard stopped the declared action; the foe's action is lost.
General.ManualCorrection: This effect has a partially completed correction. The GM must reconcile it before it can be applied again.
General.SpecialistRequired: This damage requires specialized treatment before it can be restored.
General.Taken: {name} takes the attack and an additional minor wound.
General.applicableHelp: Select applicable help (Ctrl/Cmd to select several)
General.conditionHint: Choose the duration established by the effect. Dazed usually lasts about a round. Paralysis permits actions requiring no physical movement; other unusual effects require GM adjudication.
General.confirmTreatment: Has appropriate specialized treatment been completed? Ending this restriction permits healing; it does not itself restore damage.
General.cooperationHint: Use only one cooperative mode per task or attack. Declare applicable training for Help. A complementary task grants one asset on success. Distraction is limited to one step. Guarding must be active before stopping a foe.
General.dayPassed: Has a day passed since the previous disease defense?
General.drawRoll: Draw a determined foe's attack (Intellect task)
General.drawShield: Draw the attack and block with your own shield
General.incomingHint: Choose only one mode. Taking the attack transfers its consequences plus a minor wound only if the original defense fails, once until the interceptor's next turn.
General.manualDuration: End explicitly when the declared duration is over
General.noPhysicalMovement: This action requires no physical movement
General.preventAction: Guard prevented the next declared action
General.singleTarget: Target exactly one actual character or NPC token first.
General.specialDamageHint: Enter the GM-declared consequences. Wounds, Pool damage and a condition can apply together. Repeat disease defenses each day. Declare separately if damage requires specialized treatment.
General.take: Take the attack if the defense fails
General.title: General actions and conditions
General.trackDisease: Track this ongoing disease for daily defenses (disease only)

Genre.Label: Genre
Genre.RealWorldHint: Real World: no Type or Focus — a Descriptor + Profession is enough. By default, inability with medium/heavy weapons (unless offset by a dedicated background skill).

Healing.Completed: Both participants have completed the agreed treatment time, and the treatment is applicable to this target.
Healing.HandResult: Healing Hand affects {name}; {cost} Intellect points spent.
Healing.NPCHealth: An NPC recipient regains 5 Health instead of reducing a wound.

Profiles.realistic: Real world / epic fantasy / hard sci-fi / postapocalypse

Healing.TimeProfile: Treatment time agreed with the GM

Times.major: Major: 1 hour normally; 1 week in realistic settings; 10 minutes in heroic settings.
Times.minor: Minor: 1 minute normally; 10 minutes in realistic settings; a Last action in heroic settings.
Times.moderate: Moderate: 10 minutes normally; 1 hour in realistic settings; 1 minute in heroic settings.

Healing.TouchConfirmed: The target is in contact and can receive this healing effect.

Import.Hint: Creates a new character in this system from a .json file exported by the official Cypher Character Builder. The data structure is different from this system's, so some fields (Genre, Species, weapon/skill stats) are approximated and may need manual adjustment afterward.
Import.OnlyPC: Only Player Character exports can be imported.
Import.ParseError: Couldn't read this file as valid JSON.
Import.PickFile: JSON file exported from the official Character Builder
Import.Success: {name} was imported successfully. Check Genre, Species/second descriptor, and skill/weapon stats.
Import.Title: Import a Character Builder export
Import.UnsupportedType: Item "{name}" ({type}): this item type isn't supported by the importer yet, it was skipped.
Import.WarningsCount: Import finished with {count} warning(s) — see the console (F12) for details.

Initiative.Hint: Roll Speed for initiative. Each eased step adds 3; each hindered step subtracts 3. NPCs use level times 3. A PC wins a tie with an NPC.
Initiative.Label: Initiative
Initiative.ManualCorrection: An earlier initiative correction was interrupted. The best die is retained; ask the GM to reconcile the tracker and any pending Pool refund.

Intrusion.FreeHint: A natural 1 permits a free GM intrusion. It awards no XP. The GM decides the narrative consequence.
Intrusion.NoRecipient: Assign a PC to another player before sharing this XP. The award remains pending.
Intrusion.PlayerHint: The GM decides whether this narrative change is suitable. Acceptance costs 1 XP; rejection costs nothing. It does not consume an action.
Intrusion.React: React on your next turn (1 XP)
Intrusion.ReactionHint: This reaction is available only on your next primary turn, without consuming its action.
Intrusion.ShareHint: The affected player receives 2 XP and immediately gives 1 XP to another player. The system applies the net +1 XP to each PC after that choice.
Intrusion.Unavailable: This intrusion is currently unavailable. Check XP, ownership, the active GM and any reaction deadline.
Intrusion.awaitingRecipient: Choose another player for the mandatory XP share
Intrusion.processing: Settlement in progress — resume without repeating XP changes

Migration.Begin: Cypher: migrating world data to version {version}. Keep the game open until the migration finishes.
Migration.Complete: Cypher: world data migration to version {version} complete.
Migration.TooOld: Your Cypher data (version {version}) is too old for automatic migration. Update through the intermediate versions, or request assistance.

NPC.LostNextAction: This NPC loses its next action because of a weapon effect.
NPC.ModificationsPlaceholder: e.g. attacks as level 5, +2 to Dodge...
NPC.UnsupportedAttackDamage: This NPC attack has no supported player-target damage profile.

Object.corrected: Object consequences corrected for the retained result.
Object.hardEnough: Tool at least as hard as the material?
Object.hint: At level 0 the object is broken. Only subsequent hits count toward destruction, at damage equal to its original level.
Object.ineffective: The softer tool has no effect.
Object.invalidAttack: Object attack rejected: check ownership, state and material compatibility.
Object.manual: Object consequences require GM reconciliation: subsequent changes have been preserved.
Object.resetConfirm: Clear all damage? This is an explicit GM adjudication.
Object.toolHint: Declare material compatibility; hardness is never inferred from a name

PowerShiftDescription.dexterity: Dexterity: Dodging, Speed defense rolls, movement, acrobatics, gymnastics, initiative.
PowerShiftDescription.flight: Flight*: Can fly as fast as a regular human’s ground speed; not particularly maneuverable; can carry a creature of your size or smaller.
PowerShiftDescription.healing: Healing*: One extra one-action recovery each day.
PowerShiftDescription.increasedRange: Increased Range*: Increases the range of one ability; touch or immediate becomes short, short becomes long, long becomes very long.
PowerShiftDescription.intelligence: Intelligence: Intellect defense; all knowledge skills, science skills, and crafting skills.
PowerShiftDescription.power: Power: Effects and damage of one of your character abilities, but not attack rolls with it.
PowerShiftDescription.prodigy: Prodigy*: Trade one of your tier 1 abilities for a tier 2 focus ability, or trade two tier 1 abilities for a tier 3 focus ability. (This skips earlier abilities in your focus flowchart.)
PowerShiftDescription.resilience: Resilience: Blocking, Might defense rolls, tasks requiring hardiness and endurance.
PowerShiftDescription.savant: Savant: Two specific skills (other than an attack skill, a defense skill, or a character ability that requires an attack roll), such as history, perception, or charm. You can assign this shift to an ability that treats your roll as a minimum number, such as Incredible Instinct.
PowerShiftDescription.singleAttack: Single Attack: Attack rolls and damage for one specific kind of attack, such as pistols, punches, swords, or an attack special ability like laser eyes or a psychic blast.
PowerShiftDescription.strength: Strength: Athletics, noncombat strength rolls, melee damage, thrown weapon damage.

Project.approveConfirm: Confirm genre, applicable skill or commissioned expertise, time, details and every contributor’s consent? No points are spent yet.
Project.befriendHarm: Declare harm to a befriended NPC
Project.befriendHarmConfirm: A resource-point friend was hurt or worse. Double the cost of later Befriend activities?
Project.cancelConfirm: Cancel this project without spending points?
Project.collaborationHint: Each contribution reduces the principal character’s share of the total cost. The GM confirms every contributor’s consent.
Project.completeConfirm: Confirm that the work was actually performed and all participants consent to the agreed payment and result?
Project.deferred: Points are spent only after the required time and confirmation of actual work.
Project.durationSource: Duration source (required if not one week)
Project.followerConfirmed: This NPC is the follower being restored
Project.invalid: Project action rejected: check prerequisites, permissions, time, templates and available points.
Project.investmentConfirmed: At least an expensive amount is invested; the GM confirms the fictional payment
Project.name: Goal / result name
Project.reconcileHint: Confirm that you have reconciled every resource contribution and the result externally. This control records your decision; it does not change points or repeat the result.
Project.skillAppropriate: The selected crafting skill or commissioned expertise applies
Project.sourceHint: Select a template already imported into the world or this inventory. Crafting an object without a template creates a targetable Object Actor.
Project.title: Projects and resources

Recovery.AllocationHint: Divide these points among the permitted Pools, up to each maximum. Unassigned points are unused.
Recovery.Completed: The full recovery time ({interval}) has been completed.
Recovery.InvalidAllocation: The allocation exceeds the recovered points or the current Pool limits. No recovery was consumed.
Recovery.LastAction: Use as a Last action (+2 points)
Recovery.MachinePowered: The machine has access to a suitable power supply during this recovery.
Recovery.MajorTask: Attempt a difficulty 6 Might task to remove one major wound
Recovery.MinorInstead: All minor wounds; retain one moderate wound if present
Recovery.OneModerate: One moderate wound, or all minor wounds if there are no moderate wounds
Recovery.RemovesAllModerateReminder: Removes all moderate wounds. A difficulty 6 Might task can also remove one major wound.
Recovery.RemovesMinorAndModerate: Removes all minor wounds and all but one moderate wound, if any.
Recovery.Title: Recoveries
Recovery.Unavailable: This recovery has already been used or its prerequisite is not confirmed.

Roll.ArmorSpeedHinder: Hindered by {steps} steps (armor not freely usable)
Roll.CostRefunded: The action's point cost was refunded (natural 20).
Roll.EffortDamageBonus: Effort adds {damage} damage on a hit.
Roll.ExtraModifiersHint: Declare applicable rule or circumstance modifiers. Enter assets in the Assets field. Do not count any skill, armor or power shift twice.
Roll.ExtremeRangeHinder: Extreme range: attack hindered by one step (GM adjudication).
Roll.FreeEffort: Free Effort to ease the task
Roll.FreeEffortHint: Confirm that the bonus applies, its conditions are met and uses remain available. Ordinary free levels do not count toward your Effort score, but paid and free levels together cannot exceed six, except with Superheroics. Enter wound-funded Superheroics levels separately.
Roll.InvalidModifiers: Invalid modifiers or Effort allocation. Check that values are whole numbers within the limits and that all bonuses apply.
Roll.MaxEffortHint: Maximum: {max}, based on the Effort score
Roll.PowerShiftApplicability: Confirm that these power shifts apply. Strength affects melee and thrown weapon damage; Single Attack affects the chosen kind of attack; Savant affects one of the two chosen skills; Power affects the chosen Ability’s effects and damage, excluding its attack rolls. Accuracy and Block/Dodge bonuses apply automatically.
Roll.PushDamageEffort: Superheroics levels for damage (0–2; the remaining levels ease the task)
Roll.RollRoutine: Roll the die even if this task becomes routine
Roll.RollRoutineHint: When unchecked, a routine task succeeds without a die roll or special result. Other tasks still require a roll.
Roll.SuperheroicsPush: Superheroics: take a moderate wound for two free levels (within your chosen Pool’s Effort limit)

Round.Complete: Record an action without a roll
Round.DeclarationHint: The GM confirms the action timing and prerequisites. First: only that action. Follow-up: minor nonattack activity. Last: no separate activity. Preparation occupies the entire round and grants a First action next round. Initiative scores are preserved.
Round.HeavyMovement: Immediate movement with a heavy weapon: attack hindered by one step
Round.Title: Round sequence
Round.TriggerHint: Confirm that the declared trigger is about to occur and that acting immediately before it makes sense.
Round.Unavailable: This action is unavailable in the current round slot. No costs were spent.

Shield.Absorbed: {name} absorbs the entire {severity} wound — no damage taken.
Shield.BrokenNote: {name} has taken its major wound and is destroyed.
Shield.NoneReduceInstead: None — reduce the wound by one step as usual
Shield.RemainingReduced: The {count} remaining incoming wounds were resolved by reducing their severity by one step on the character.
Shield.SheetHint: Any character can use a shield freely, regardless of their Type. On a successful Block, choose to reduce the wound by one step as usual, or have it absorbed entirely by an equipped shield.
Shield.Title: Shields
Shield.UseShield: Use a shield (successful Block = whole wound absorbed)

ShieldAbility.ChooseIntrusion: GM: replace the lost turn with an intrusion
ShieldAbility.EffectEffort: Spend one Effort level to hinder a hit target for one round
ShieldAbility.IntrusionChosen: The GM chose an intrusion instead of the lost turn from Unyielding Shield. Resolve that intrusion with the GM.
ShieldAbility.InvalidUse: This shield operation is unavailable. Check ownership, designation, equipment state, targets, resources and the work deadline.
ShieldAbility.LandsImmediate: The shield is not in hand. After a failed catch, Bouncing Shield lands within immediate range. Retrieve it before using it again.
ShieldAbility.LandsShort: The shield is not in hand. After a failed catch, it most likely lands a short distance away. Retrieve it before using it again.
ShieldAbility.RangeConfirmed: The targets are within the required range
ShieldAbility.RangeHint: For attacks, confirm melee reach or short throwing range. Target order is attack order; Bouncing Shield permits the third target to be the first target again.
ShieldAbility.ResourcesConfirm: Confirm that the required resources and crafting skill or outside arrangements have been provided. Hidden Shield repair takes about one day; an Unyielding Shield replacement takes 1d6 days of concerted effort. The CRD gives no fixed resource price, so this requires adjudication.
ShieldAbility.StaleCatch: The retained roll succeeded, but this catch's consequences can no longer be confirmed automatically. Check the shield's current location and any point-cost refund with the GM.
ShieldAbility.TurnLossPending: Unyielding Shield survived a major wound. Your next turn is lost unless the GM chooses an intrusion instead. The combat tracker skips that turn automatically; outside combat, acknowledge the lost turn here.
ShieldAbility.TurnLost: The next turn was lost because of Unyielding Shield.
ShieldAbility.WorkCompletedConfirm: Confirm that the required repair or replacement work has actually been completed. Its game-time deadline must also have elapsed.
ShieldAbility.WorkReady: Work deadline elapsed; confirm completion through the ability control
ShieldAbility.WorkStarted: Shield work started: {days} day(s) of work required.
ShieldAbility.bind: Designate an existing shield for this ability
ShieldAbility.create: Create the shield granted by this ability
ShieldAbility.melee: Attack with the shield in melee
ShieldAbility.paired: Main attack and extra Hidden Shield attack (both hindered)

Superhero.ChoosePool: Choose the Pool enhanced by Superheroics
Superhero.Hint: Each category is capped at 3. Most shifts grant permanent bonuses to applicable tasks, outside the Effort limit; special categories follow their own rules. Tasks can reach difficulty 15 in this genre.

TaskRetry.blocked: The GM has ruled that further attempts at this task are impossible.
TaskRetry.closed: The interrupted predecessor was closed after explicit GM reconciliation.
TaskRetry.confirm: I confirm this is the same task, takes the same time, and remains possible in the fiction.
TaskRetry.continued: This failed attempt has already led to a new attempt. Use the latest eligible failed card.
TaskRetry.duration: Original duration (same duration for this attempt)
TaskRetry.hint: This is a new attempt at the same ordinary task, not an XP reroll. Apply at least one paid Effort level; Edge still reduces its point cost. Previous costs and results remain.
TaskRetry.interrupted: A new attempt was interrupted after its checkpoint. Do not replay it; ask the GM to reconcile the action, costs and chat.
TaskRetry.invalid: The new attempt was refused. Check paid Effort, current resources, duration and action availability.
TaskRetry.label: Task being attempted again
TaskRetry.reconcile: First reconcile the actual action usage, costs and any published result. Confirming closes this interrupted predecessor; it does not refund points, roll again or restore previous state.
TaskRetry.unavailable: This card is not an eligible failed ordinary task, or its recorded task has already succeeded.

Type.AlreadyApplied: A Type has already been applied to this character.
Type.ApplyPrompt: Apply the mechanical benefits of {name} to this character?

Type.StatOptions: Pools eligible for the Edge bonus

Warning.ActionPermission: You cannot change this character or target. Ask the GM to resolve the action.
Warning.CannotRallyMajor: You can't rally to remove a major wound (outside the superhero genre).
Warning.CapabilitiesMustSumFour: The distribution must add up to exactly 4 points.
Warning.CharacterDied: {name} has taken a third major wound and dies.
Warning.ChooseAdvancementType: Choose an advancement type for this slot first.

WeaponAbility.Adjacent: The GM confirms that all three targets are next to one another.
WeaponAbility.AvailableUses: Available uses (ammunition, power, or thrown weapons)

WeaponAbility.InvalidUse: Check the weapon, targets, adjacency or reach, available uses, and Pool points before using this ability.
WeaponAbility.TargetDifficulty: Each attack uses its target's level as difficulty. Effort is paid separately for each attack.
WeaponAbility.ThrownInReach: This attack uses multiple thrown weapons carried or within reach.
WeaponAbility.UsesConsumed: Spray: {uses} uses of ammunition, power, or thrown weapons.

Wound.Hint: The default capacity is three wounds of each severity. A full moderate wound track hinders all tasks. Each major wound adds one step of hindrance to all tasks. Three major wounds cause death.
Wound.Rally: Rally (spend Might points to remove this wound)
Wound.Title: Wounds

XP.AttackCorrectionApplied: The retained attack result was applied using its recorded damage contribution and original effect interval.
XP.AttackCorrectionManual: This attack's consequences can no longer be reconciled safely. Ask the GM to apply the retained result; this reroll made no further automatic target changes.
XP.AttackNarrativeEffect: Resolve the retained minor or major effect with the GM, replacing any narrative effect of the previous result.
XP.ChooseBetterReroll: Choose which result is better for your character.
XP.DefenseCorrectionApplied: The retained defense result was applied. Only this defense's recorded damage was corrected; later wounds remain unchanged.
XP.DefenseCorrectionManual: This defense's previous damage can no longer be identified safely. Ask the GM to apply the retained result. No damage was automatically corrected by this reroll.
XP.EditInHeader: Edit XP directly in the sheet header.
XP.Label: XP
XP.LuckyShotHint2: Lucky Shot (1 XP): available directly in the attack roll dialog, to attempt a blind attack.
XP.PlayerIntrusionPrompt: Describe how you alter the situation in your favor.
XP.RerollCompare: Previous result: {old} — New result: {new} — Retained result: {final}
XP.RerollHint: Reroll (1 XP): use the button below an eligible chat roll immediately after the roll, for your character or another player’s.
